title: 27:11 women come, and set them on fire. Withered wood will be all that remains of value once the homes and cities are destroyed; women will seek for wood, using it as fuel for cooking and warmth. There is a spiritual meaning here: After the destruction of idolatry (27:9) and the desolation of cities and homes (27:10) in the last days, all that will remain will be the burning, representing the burning at the Second Coming.
author: Tina M. Peterson
